summary: Frontend-only testing of /inscricao.html. Verified BUG FIX: no duplicated 'Escolher arquivo' button anymore. Custom .doc-file-btn is the only visible button; native file input has opacity:0 and is absolutely positioned overlaying the custom button. File-name label updates and gets 'has-file' class on selection. All ancillary form behaviors (NOME uppercase, CPF mask + invalid CPF error, DATA_NASCIMENTO mask, CELULAR mask, CEP autofill via /api/cep) work as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: inscricao.html is a large single HTML file (~600 lines) mixing HTML/CSS/JS - consider splitting shared styles/scripts into external assets in public/ for maintainability, but not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for duplicated 'Escolher arquivo' button in /inscricao.html is verified working. Verified: DOC_TIPO=CNH reveals #doc-uploads; exactly 2 .doc-file-btn (Frente/Verso) visible, native file inputs #DOC_FRENTE/#DOC_VERSO have opacity=0 position=absolute overlay. Uploading a file updates #DOC_FRENTE_name text and adds 'has-file' green class. Also verified NOME uppercase, CPF mask (123.456.789-00) + 'CPF inválido' error visible, DATA_NASCIMENTO 01/01/1990 mask, CELULAR (11) 99999-8888 mask, CEP 66017000 auto-fills LOGRADOURO='AVENIDA PRESIDENTE VARGAS', BAIRRO='CAMPINA', CIDADE='BELÉM', UF='PA' via /api/cep.
rca of the issue: The prior duplication occurred because both the styled div .doc-file-btn and the default native input[type=file] chooser were rendered visibly. Fix places the native input absolutely over the styled button with opacity:0 so only the custom button is seen while clicks still open the file dialog. A companion script updates .doc-file-name on change. Verified via DOM inspection and screenshot.
